uninstall:
deckent uninstall [--keep-data | --keep-work | --all] [--force]
[--disable-unit] [--yes] [--dry-run [--verbose]]
Without a tier, a menu offers: Remove, keep my data (default; only caches go and
the service stops); Remove, keep pending work (also archives and deletes
conversation data; shown when work is pending); Delete everything (backup
first). Each menu step has the flag of the same name. Every check runs before
the one confirmation, and nothing is asked when there is nothing to remove.
Every tier that deletes data first writes a passphrase-protected backup and an
encrypted archive of the other files it deletes, verified, in your private
recovery folder outside every deleted folder; deckent backup restore brings both
back. --all then deletes the project's .deckent, DECKENT.md and the bridge line
init wrote; files your Git tracks and unknown files stay and are listed; a
folder goes only when empty.
--force cancels running work and rejects pending approvals with your own
authority; it never closes unknown results, steals a lock or kills a process.
--disable-unit prints the exact manual command for a unit Deckent did not create
and refuses automatic changes; the unit file stays. --yes skips only the final
card; the plan is still printed. --dry-run and --json only preview; --verbose
also lists absent items. Applying needs a person at their own terminal; policy,
retention and legal holds apply. Worker images and the program are removed by
you with the printed commands.

Remove Deckent from this folder; keeps your data by default.
